name: walk-bot
summary: A bot that plays the player's pawn unattended (seeded wandering or a set route) and reports stuck spots, falls out of the level, sliding, impossible speed and a camera inside geometry. With no renderer an hour of walking costs seconds; a failing seed replays exactly, with pictures.

MODULE.description: The C++ game module the two source files join (the directory under Source/).

MODULE_API.description: That module's export macro, for example MYGAME_API.

adapt: Add "EnhancedInput" to PublicDependencyModuleNames in Source/<Module>/<Module>.Build.cs (the bot injects into the game's move action when it has one).
Close the editor, then compile: node Tools/gam3/ue_build.mjs

Run it once and read the note lines: input=enhanced means it found the game's move action; input=movement means it calls AddMovementInput. If the action was not found, pass --move-action with its asset name.
Write down the paths a player must be able to walk (spawn to the first objective, through each door) as route files, one x,y,z per line.
For a game with more than walking, bind UGam3WalkBot::OnBotTick: do the game's actions there and call ReportIncident for the game's own rules.
Where the game moves the player on purpose (respawn, door, cutscene), call NoteTeleport() first.
verify: node Tools/gam3/ue_walk.mjs --seconds 30   (the summary line must start GAM3WALK: ok)

verified.how: Compiled into a C++ test project with ready-gate, using a test character and an arena built at run time. Blind profile: a clean 60 s wander passed; 600 s took 2.6 s and 3600 s took 13.4 s after start-up (about 230 to 270 times real time), 17.3 km walked; the same seed three times gave the same distance and end position, and the same again through the Enhanced Input path. Deliberate defects were each reported by name: a pawn wedged between walls and a closed 1.4 m pocket (stuck), a closed 3 m room (stuck, pacing rule), a floor with no edge walls and a floor height (fell), a 9 m teleport and a 1500 cm/s boost (speed; a teleport announced with NoteTeleport passed), an idle animation while moving (slide), a camera placed 3 m behind the pawn near walls (camera-inside), and a game rule reported through OnBotTickNative. Routes: four waypoints walked, a wall across the route failed as stuck, a time limit too short failed as unfinished, a route file was read, and a move action mapped a quarter turn off was measured and corrected. --replay at the agent profile repeated each incident at the same place and game time and wrote one picture per incident; the pictures were opened. The bot also ran inside ue_game.mjs without -Gam3BotSeconds and wrote its result at exit. Not run: the nan check, the pawn-destroyed path of fell, the Blueprint OnBotTick delegate, a real game's input assets (the test actions were made in code), play in editor, packaged builds, Windows and Linux. 0.2.0: no Blueprint exposure; OnBotTick is now the native delegate (OnBotTickNative still fires). Recompiled and a 20 s blind wander passed.
